strings.subtitle: — Fiŋolu labaŋo —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ñaaniŋ bokaŋo te jaŋ. Ñiŋ botoŋo duuma la.
strings.ft_lnk: Sila kuruŋ (.lnk) — a be batu la
strings.ssd_warning:
Kebaa! SSD kaŋ, tiliŋ saafoŋo maŋ sabari labaŋo la TRIM la.
Ñiŋ porogaraamu ye HDD ye.
strings.confirm_text:
Fiŋo "{name}" be saafoŋo la kaŋ, a be bo la.

Ñiŋ ñaata?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Fiŋo maŋ ke a karaŋ no la:
{err}
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS sila doomaa data (ADS) maŋ dookuwo ke.
• USN kitaaboo maŋ sama.
• Ndiyaa koppiŋolu niŋ saŋ fatariŋolu
  (OneDrive, atg.) maŋ bata.
strings.status_full: A kono bee saafoŋo kaŋ niŋ zeri la. A maŋ ñaama — kuranko be zeri doroŋ ne je.
strings.status_fast: Kuuŋ, kuntu, niŋ 4 MB siriŋolu saafoŋo kaŋ. A toomaa maŋ bata, saayiŋ baa la, labaŋo bee kuranko maŋ ñaama. Kunnafoni dogolu ye FAA mode taa.
strings.status_empty: Fiŋo faŋka, saafoŋo maŋ ñaata. A bota.
strings.error_permission: Fiŋo maŋ ñaama kutu. A bɛ se ka ke porogaraamu doo kono. A taa, a ke jaŋ.
strings.error_not_found: Fiŋo maŋ ñaama. A bɛ se ka ke a bota.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ñiŋ ye sila nɔɔ la. Sila nɔolu maŋ ñaama labaŋo la — fiŋo tigi be tu la a bɛɛ.
strings.error_reparse: Ñiŋ ye fiŋo jaa la (OneDrive walla a ñɔɔ). A data be saŋ fatariŋo kono, a te disk kaŋ — jaŋ data te.
strings.error_not_file: Ñiŋ maŋ ke fiŋo ye (folda walla doo). Fiŋo jindi.
strings.error_hardlinks: Ñiŋ fiŋo ye sila nɔɔ doolu la ({n} bee). Sila nɔolu maŋ ke kuu ye — toolu bee kaŋ kiliŋ. Niŋ i ye labaŋ sila to la, data be saafoŋo kaŋ, a be kuntu la 32 byte ma, saayiŋ a toomaa be tu la sila doolu la. Sila bee bo, foloo.
strings.error_compressed:
Fiŋo dundiŋta, hulinta, walla a fanen. Saafoŋo niŋ zeri maŋ sabari data kuruŋo labaŋo la, NTFS ye a mara kuma doo la.

Kabunda: kliku toomaa → Nɔɔyaa → Ñaamantaa → kabunda tikiŋ "Dundiŋ" walla "Hulin". Saayiŋ SHREDDER ke jaŋ.
